items.abstract: <jats:p>The end-Permian mass extinction was the most severe biotic crisis of the Phanerozoic, yet temporal synchrony between marine and terrestrial extinctions remains debated due to correlation uncertainties. Here, we present an integrated magnetostratigraphic, cyclostratigraphic, and carbon-isotope and mercury (Hg) chemostratigraphic record from the fluvial Upper Shihhotse, Sunjiagou, and Liujiagou formations at the Sigou section, North China. We identify 14 magnetozones spanning the late Changhsingian to late Olenekian, constrained by a floating timescale based on gamma-ray cyclostratigraphy and subsequently anchored through magnetostratigraphic correlation. Our chronostratigraphy reveals a Hg peak at 252.4 Ma, aligning with the main eruptive phase of the Siberian Traps Large Igneous Province, while the carbon isotope excursion onset (252.1 Ma) and minimum (252.0 Ma) are synchronous with the Meishan Global Stratotype Section and Point. Furthermore, the Induan–Olenekian boundary is positioned below magnetozone SG4n, constraining the Induan Stage duration to 1.6 to 1.8 My. These findings establish a high-resolution chronostratigraphic framework for the Permian–Triassic boundary in North China, supporting a synchronous extinction zenith across marine and low–middle latitude terrestrial ecosystems, with latitudinal diachroneity relative to high-latitude and tropical landmasses.</jats:p>
items.summary: 《华北低中纬度陆相与海相二叠纪末大灭绝同步达到顶峰》：该研究整合磁性地层、旋回地层及碳同位素与汞化学地层记录，建立华北四沟剖面高分辨率年代地层框架，识别出252.4百万年汞峰值与西伯利亚大火成岩省主喷发期对应，碳同位素异常与煤山全球界线层型剖面同步，为海陆大灭绝同步性及纬度差异提供新证据，值得地层学与古生物学者阅读。
items.title: Synchronous end-Permian mass extinction zenith in marine and low–middle latitude terrestrial North China
items.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

items.abstract: Abstract Lower-limb alignment is central to human bipedal locomotion and a key determinant of joint kinematics and osteoarthritis risk in modern clinical practice. However, its significance in hominins, and therefore its evolutionary implications, remain poorly understood. Advances in robotic-assisted total knee arthroplasty (TKA) provide highly precise measurements of lower-limb alignment, joint morphology and soft-tissue balance that can elucidate these understudied aspects of hominin functional morphology. Here, we perform a proof-of-concept robotic-assisted TKA on an anatomically accurate model of the Spy II Neandertal. Using a robotic-assistance system, we registered bony morphology and replicated soft-tissue laxity extrapolated from a modern patient with a comparable alignment phenotype. We confirmed a pronounced constitutional varus alignment, classifying Spy II as a CPAK type I knee. This phenotype resembles that of modern athletes engaged in significant weight-bearing sports or intense physical activity during growth. The demonstration of constitutional varus in a hominin fossil thus suggests a deep evolutionary origin for this alignment pattern in modern humans, contextualizing normal knee variation and supporting an individualized alignment approach to modern TKA.
items.summary: 《机器人辅助膝关节置换术为尼安德特人步态及现代人膝关节变异的进化起源提供线索》：研究对Spy II尼安德特人解剖模型实施机器人辅助全膝关节置换术，确认其存在明显先天性膝内翻，归类为CPAK I型，类似现代高强度负重运动人群，提示该力线模式在现代人中具有深层进化起源，值得关注。
items.title: Robotic-assisted knee arthroplasty methods provide insight into Homo neanderthalensis gait and the evolutionary origins of modern human knee variation
